messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — running a compact launch-readiness runbook for the cloud marketplace push next Tue. High-level asks: press embargo & asset handoff, landing page + tracking, SI integration checklist, and hardware partner certification notes. Who can own the integrations checklist?

priya: I can own integrations. Will draft SI onboarding checklist and test plan. Need to know partner submission format and staging tenant.

marta_s: For press — we need embargo time (pdf/asset drop) + canonical headline and TL;DR for press kit. Also want final landing hero copy by Thu EOD. Can someone own copy?

tomg: Re: integrations checklist — minimal items: package listing, container/AMI reference, SSO/OAuth redirect URIs, billing metadata, usage metrics hooks. Also add compatibility matrix for our dedicated and private offerings. Example manifest snippet we ask partners to provide:
```
{
  "name": "Partner Integration Package",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "images": ["us.gcr.io/partner/app:stable"],
  "sso": { "redirect_uris": ["https://partner.example.com/callback"] },
  "marketplace_metadata": { "sku": "rdw-market-001", "billing_model": "subscription" }
}
```
I'll put this in the integrations doc.

jen_ops: Staging tenant for submissions: https://staging-marketplace.redwood-internal/ (test creds in 1Password: Marketplace/TestTenant). Quick submit command for partners to test packaging: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging-marketplace.redwood-internal/api/v1/submit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -F "package=@partner-package.zip" \
  -F "metadata=@manifest.json"
```
Use tenant_id=staging-87 in the payload.

partner-bot: :spiral_calendar: Reminder: Press embargo set by partner for 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC. Update delivered assets before 2026-05-10 17:00 UTC to avoid delays.

alex_k: Timeline proposal:
- Fri 2026-05-08: Finalize integrations checklist + partner manifest template (priya, tomg)
- Mon 2026-05-11: Landing page draft & tracking tags ready (marta_s, jen_ops)
- Tue 2026-05-12 08:00 UTC: Internal go/no-go at 08:00 (all)
- Tue 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC: Press embargo lifts / publish
I'll add these to the shared runbook and tag owners.

priya: Quick Q — do we want partners to provide telemetry hooks (prometheus metrics endpoint) or only event webhooks? SI teams prefer metrics, GTM prefers webhooks for usage signals. My plan: require webhooks and strongly recommend metrics.

marta_s: Recommend both — webhooks for billing events, metrics for health. We'll call out that metrics are optional but required for Dedicated certification.

tomg: Heads-up on hardware partners: certification window may add 2 days if partners request hardware-validated images. Flagging for infra to bump validation.

jen_ops: I'll reserve a final staging run on 2026-05-10 20:00 UTC for end-to-end validation (package submit + landing + analytics smoke). Need owners to be on-call for that slot.

alex_k: Thanks — action items: priya (integrations doc), marta_s (press + copy), jen_ops (staging run & submission flow), tomg (compatibility notes + cert flag). I'll loop in Solutions Eng for SI KB.

marta_s: Partner press contact is Emily Zhao (emily@partnerco.com). I'll DM to get headshot + exec quote.

priya: I'll start drafting the checklist now, will ping when PR is up.

tomg: Noted. If any partner requests hardware validation, ping me and I'll prioritize.

jen_ops: Copy — adding owners to the calendar invite and runbook doc. :white_check_mark:

alex_k: Great — closing thread, will push the runbook link shortly. :rocket:
